# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the PhotoAlbum application.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) — high-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) — declared production and test dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) — HTTP surface, page-handler contracts, and request flow sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) — persistence model, entity diagram, and data ownership notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) — configuration sources, settings inventory, runtime profiles, and secret handling summary.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) — domain workflows, business rules, and primary upload sequence.
